svg.title: Octopus chef at a ramen booth
svg.desc: A cheerful pink octopus chef in a toque and hachimaki, using all eight arms at once behind a glowing Japanese yatai ramen stall at night.

text.font-family: Hiragino Maru Gothic ProN, Yu Gothic, sans-serif

g.text: いらっしゃいませ！ — Eight arms, one perfect bowl.
